implementation.author_components: Prompt literal, filter_response function, calculate_llm_human_proportion scorer, sampled queries; Contriever mean pooling and unnormalized inner product follow the supplied author configuration
adaptations: Replace full Wikipedia index with union of top-20 DPR contexts for matched questions
Replace multi-model multi-dataset writes with one local generator writing one document per question per round
Use exact numpy inner-product ranking instead of LangChain/Faiss/Elasticsearch orchestration
Select intended prompt explicitly: upstream Mode maps both Zero-shot and With-context to 0; avoid that ambiguous dispatcher
Use fixed per-request seeds; retain temperature 0.7, max_tokens 128, top_p 1, presence_penalty 0.6, five context documents, 100-word cap and author post-processing
Two concurrent local requests; up to three attempts for too-short generation, retaining attempts and varying fixed seed by attempt
Use the official public Contriever MS MARCO checkpoint; the exact bytes of the authors historical local contriever-base-msmarco folder are not published. Batch size 32 instead of 512.
implementation.models: Local Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct Q4_K_M generator and CPU facebook/contriever-msmarco retriever

embedding.pooling: attention-mask mean pooling through SentenceTransformer, as in the author HuggingFaceEmbeddings wrapper
